title: sbom
summary: Writes a CycloneDX 1.6 JSON software bill of materials for a project from its index: the application, one component per library its units reach, and their dependencies (v1: source closure, no MAP input)
intro: Read this when a customer, an auditor or the EU Cyber Resilience Act asks which third-party code your application contains. sbom reads the project index and the library index, groups every unit of the compile closure into components, and names each one from an editable library catalogue (supplier, version, licence, purl). A library the catalogue does not know is still listed, as 'unknown supplier'. v1 works from source only: what it cannot see (units linked from DCUs, packages, DLLs) is stated inside the document.

help: CycloneDX 1.6 JSON software bill of materials from the project index (v1 slice: source closure).
One component per unit group: every unit of the project index, each unit its uses rows reach in a
library index (transitively), and each used unit with no source. The catalogue
rules\sbom-libraries.json (edit it, or --catalogue) gives supplier, name, version, licence, purl;
a group with no row is listed with the supplier "unknown supplier", never dropped (NOTE on stderr).
metadata.component = the application; --app-version states its version, --exe adds the SHA-512 of
the delivered file. dependencies = uses edges between the groups. Read-only.
v1 limits, stated in the document (compositions "incomplete", drag-lint:sbom:scope): no MAP input,
so units linked from DCUs that no indexed source names, runtime packages and DLLs are not listed;
no BSI TR-03183-2 profile; no VEX. --library-db none = direct uses only.
Exit 0 = written (--out, else stdout); 1 = an index, the catalogue or --exe cannot be read;
2 = no --project / no index for it; 3 = unknown flag.

questions.ask: Which third-party libraries does this application contain, with supplier and licence?
How do I produce the SBOM of the version I deliver, with the hash of the executable?
Which libraries does the SBOM list as unknown supplier, so I can add them to the catalogue?
questions.command: drag-lint sbom --project <App.dproj> --out <App.cdx.json>   (the NOTE lines on stderr name each one and its directory)
